description:
We provide Akron, Ohio and Cleveland Ohio home buyers with clear and concise information so they can make an informed decision about the home they are considering purchasing with a 100% money back guarantee. Our inspection reports are one of the largest negotiating tools a home buyer could purchase. We save home buyers thousands of dollars and help prevent them from purchasing the money pit.

We provide our clients the information they need to make an informed decision about the property being inspected in a clear, concise, professional manner, onsite with digital photographs of defects.

Services: Home buyers inspection, sellers inspection, new construction warranty inspection, radon gas testing, wood destroying insect inspections, sewer video inspections, infrared thermal imaging inspection, commercial building inspection, multi-family commercial building.
